title: Proxy
description: VPN connectivity history, client-facing traffic and egress traffic. Service-level aggregation independent of physical hosts.

panels.title: Website connectivity · Direct / VPN
panels.description: Each cell shows reachability history: green 1 / red 0, one-minute minimum. Missing, stale or unreachable probe observations are gaps. Direct and VPN share the same observer. Configured targets remain visible for 24h after last metadata; all cells share the selected time range. Datacenter vantage point, not every residential ISP.

targets.expr: min by(source_zone,site) (min_over_time(probe_success{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}",check="client-web",access="direct"}[1m]) and on(job,instance,site,access,check) (probe_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}",check="client-web",access="direct"} > time() - 60) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}"}) > time() - 45))) or on(source_zone,site) (0 * max by(source_zone,site) (max_over_time(probe_target_info{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}",check="client-web",access="direct"}[24h])) / 0)

min by(source_zone,site) (min_over_time(probe_success{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}",check="client-web",access="vpn"}[1m]) and on(job,instance,site,access,check) (probe_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}",check="client-web",access="vpn"} > time() - 60) and on(job,instance) ((up{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}"}) > time() - 45))) or on(source_zone,site) (0 * max by(source_zone,site) (max_over_time(probe_target_info{job="vpn-client-probes",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",source_zone=~"${source_zone:regex}",check="client-web",access="vpn"}[24h])) / 0)

panels.title: VPN component traffic
panels.description: Gateway: end-user ingress bytes. Egress: freedom outbound bytes, including synthetic probes. These are different measurement points; do not sum gateway and egress as unique traffic. Internal relay transport is excluded from gateway client totals.

targets.expr: 8 * (sum by(cluster,zone) ((rate(xray_traffic_uplink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="user"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(job,instance) (((xray_up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1)) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"}) > time() - 90)))) + sum by(cluster,zone) ((rate(xray_traffic_downlink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="user"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(job,instance) (((xray_up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1)) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"}) > time() - 90)))))

8 * (sum by(cluster,zone) ((rate(xray_traffic_uplink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="outbound",target=~"direct|ru-direct"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(job,instance) (((xray_up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1)) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"}) > time() - 90)))) + sum by(cluster,zone) ((rate(xray_traffic_downlink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="outbound",target=~"direct|ru-direct"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(job,instance) (((xray_up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1)) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"}) > time() - 90)))))

panels.title: Traffic by client · top 100
panels.description: Upload + download at client-facing gateways. Stable top 100 by bytes during the selected range. Relay/probe accounts excluded before storage; IDs are pseudonymous, never VLESS UUID credentials. A client seen in several zones is summed once across its entry counters.

targets.expr: (8 * (sum by(cluster,target) ((rate(xray_traffic_uplink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="user"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(job,instance) (((xray_up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1)) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"}) > time() - 90)))) + sum by(cluster,target) ((rate(xray_traffic_downlink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="user"}[$__rate_interval]) and on(job,instance) (((xray_up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"} == 1)) and on(job,instance) (timestamp(up{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}"}) > time() - 90)))))) and on(cluster,target) topk(100, sum by(cluster,target) (increase(xray_traffic_uplink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="user"}[$__range] @ end())) + sum by(cluster,target) (increase(xray_traffic_downlink_bytes_total{job="xray",service="gateway",cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",zone=~"${zone:regex}",dimension="user"}[$__range] @ end())))
